description: Hard-case eval set for the Claude sentiment classifier (src/lib/providers/claude-sentiment.ts). Not a substitute for a large labeled dataset — a small, deliberately curated set of known trap patterns (sarcasm, negation, wistful-but-not-critical romance/tragedy content, emoji-only, mixed reactions) to check that a model swap or fine-tune doesn't regress on failure modes that have already bitten this pipeline once. Run against it with scripts/eval-sentiment-model.mjs before trusting a different model in production. Cases are deliberately NOT copied verbatim from the SYSTEM_PROMPT's own illustrative examples in claude-sentiment.ts — the model has already seen those exact strings in its instructions, so scoring them right could be pattern-matching against the prompt rather than generalizing the underlying principle.

sources.documented-regression: Traces to README.md's documented 2026-07-24 finding: Sonnet (pre-Sonnet-5) scored wistful/sad-but-not-critical heartbreak comments as negative, which is why the pipeline moved to Opus. Paraphrased, not verbatim.
sources.prompt-principle: Paraphrases a reasoning principle from SYSTEM_PROMPT (sarcasm/negation on fan slang, emoji-only signal, mixed reactions) without reusing its literal example text.
sources.control: Plain, unambiguous case with no trap — sanity check that a model isn't failing at the easy majority, not just the hard tail.

cases.text: she left the story but never left my heart, that's the kind of ache this film gives you 🖤
cases.trap: wistful/sad romance content, not criticism of the film

cases.text: everyone in the theatre was crying at the end, some heartbreaks stay with you forever
cases.trap: sad theme described appreciatively, not a quality complaint
hype word ("mass") used sarcastically/mockingly, not literally
hype word undercut by an eye-roll emoji

cases.text: not exactly what I'd call a blockbuster

cases.trap: bittersweet emoji reacting to a sad-but-good moment, not a complaint — also tests emoji-only signal

cases.text: acting was solid but this trailer edit is all over the place, still hyped though
cases.trap: mixed reaction — praise for actor + criticism of trailer, but hype is dominant

cases.text: total waste of money, terrible script and worse acting
cases.trap: plain negative control — should be easy for any model

cases.text: can't wait for this one, hype level maximum 🔥
when is this releasing? anyone know the date
cases.trap: plain neutral control — pure question, no sentiment
